    "exact_reduction": {
      "anti_invariant_y": "Target Y has the form Y=w*H with H in K(C).",
      "canonical_model": "With canonical differential basis proportional to {dR/w, dR/t, dR/(w*t), R*dR/(w*t)}, the canonical affine coordinates are [t:w:1:R]. The canonical curve is the intersection w^2=t(R+2) and t^2=R^3-3R; the quadric is rank 3 (a cone), exposing the trigonal structure.",
      "cover_branch_points": [
        "O (point at infinity)",
        "(0,0)",
        "(sqrt(3),0)",
        "(-sqrt(3),0)",
        "(-2,i*sqrt(2))",
        "(-2,-i*sqrt(2))"
      ],
      "critical_profile": "The three Q points are exactly the C-points whose two lifts ramify f with index 2. For X:C->P1, a Q has local degree 2 if its critical value is non-special and local degree 4 if its critical value is one of {0,1,lambda,infinity}. All other critical points of X are ordinary double points in special fibers. If s of the three Q have special critical values, the special fibers contribute 9+s to the X ramification divisor and the remaining Q contribute 3-s, totaling 12 as required by Riemann-Hurwitz.",
      "delta": "delta=t*d/dR on K(C).",
      "descended_x": "X=x∘f lies in K(C), and deg(X:C->P1)=6.",
      "differential_identity": "delta(X)=c*H*(t+k).",
      "double_cover": "pi:D->C is w^2=(R+2)t with involution iota(w)=-w.",
      "fiber_product_identity": "A*X*(X-1)*(X-lambda)=(R+2)*t*H^2 for a nonzero target twist constant A.",
      "hilbert_class_relation": "j(lambda)^2-4834944*j(lambda)+14670139392=0 (discriminant -24 class polynomial).",
      "k_square": "k^2=12*sqrt(2)-10*sqrt(3).",
      "lambda_square": "lambda=((2-sqrt(3))*(sqrt(3)-sqrt(2)))^2.",
      "legendre_j": "j(lambda)=2417472+1707264*sqrt(2).",
      "normalized_equivariance": "For any candidate f with f^*omega_E=c*phi, after target translation one may normalize f∘iota=[-1]∘f.",
      "ode_certificate": "(R+2)*t*(delta(X))^2=K*(t+k)^2*X*(X-1)*(X-lambda), K=A*c^2 != 0.",
      "phi_zero_divisor": "phi has six simple zeros: the two lifts to D of each of the three distinct points Q on C satisfying t=-k.",
      "q_cubic": "The R-coordinates of the Q points satisfy R^3-3R-k^2=0.",
      "q_cubic_discriminant": "disc=216*(30*sqrt(6)-73)>0, hence the three Q are distinct.",
      "remaining_branch_block_patterns": [
        "4+2+0+0",
        "2+2+2+0"
      ],
      "six_block_obstruction": "The branch-block pattern 6+0+0+0 is impossible for the frozen lambda. After a target 2-torsion translation put the size-6 block over infinity. Let F=(R+2)t, so div(F)=B_total-6O, and write G=F*X in L(6O). Then G, G-F, and G-lambda*F all have even divisors. Every even-divisor element of L(6O) is either a square of an element of L(3O), or (R-r) times a square of an element of L(2O) for r in {0,sqrt(3),-sqrt(3)}. Two non-square 2-torsion types cannot differ by a nonzero multiple of F because they contain no t term. Factoring the difference of two square types forces the L(3O) factors to split F as (R+2)*t. The only possible cross-ratios are the anharmonic exceptional values lambda in {-1,1/2,2} (or the degenerate 0,1 cases). The frozen lambda has j=2417472+1707264*sqrt(2), whereas all {-1,1/2,2} give j=1728, so this pattern is excluded.",
      "special_fiber_even_partitions": [
        "The six D/C branch points map to the four special x-values in even block sizes.",
        "Ignoring zero blocks, the branch-point block-size patterns are 6; 4+2; or 2+2+2.",
        "A special fiber containing a Q point can contain at most two D/C branch points."
      ],
      "special_fiber_profile": "For a in {0,1,lambda,infinity}, let m=ord_p(X-a) (or pole order at infinity). At p in branch(D/C), m=1 because f is unramified there. At ordinary non-branch p not among Q, m=2 if X(p)=a. If a Q point lies over a special value, then m=4 because f has ramification index 2 and x:E->P1 has ramification index 2 there. Thus parity(m) is odd exactly on branch(D/C)."
    },
    "frozen_inputs": {
      "C": "t=w^2/(R+2), t^2=R^3-3R",
      "D": "w^4=(R+2)^2*R*(R^2-3)",
      "k": "-i*3^(1/4)*(sqrt(6)-2)",
      "lambda": "35+24*sqrt(2)-20*sqrt(3)-14*sqrt(6)",
      "phi": "dR/w*(1+k/t)",
      "required_degree": 6
    },

Construct a degree-6 X in K(C) satisfying the ODE certificate and the corrected local-degree rules for one of the remaining patterns 4+2+0+0 or 2+2+2+0, then recover H, target twist, exact pullback coefficient and period scaling; or prove both remaining patterns impossible.",
